recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless Pharmacy later decides to reintroduce a MedicationKnowledge device-model element, in which case a new tracker should define the current element and target.
issue_request: FHIR-32159 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R5 asking that MedicationKnowledge.device reference DeviceDefinition rather than Device because MedicationKnowledge is definitional and should identify a device model/kind, not an actual device instance.
initial_application: Commit 934e7819020c72ee6e3ba509ecb5445a1850f109 applied the issue by changing MedicationKnowledge.device from targetProfile Device to targetProfile DeviceDefinition in source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge remains active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Later commit 6422f2f98a0fcf03140c15fe93bfd6c765fc6377 removed MedicationKnowledge.device and MedicationKnowledge.packaging.device while reorganizing definitional and packaging details. Current MedicationKnowledge source has no stale Device target, and no exact-key Zulip discussion was found that changes the Jira/Confluence/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because there is no current source correction to make: the issue was applied, and the later current source no longer contains the affected element.
